claims.statement: CoinPaprika resolved AERO to Aerodrome Finance, coin ID aero-aerodrome-finance, and returned contract 0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631. The returned contract entry is typed 'Other'; this response does not independently establish Base chain attribution.

At CoinPaprika last_updated 2026-10-16T11:15:15Z, AERO was $0.9250627991 USD, with reported market cap $928,958,574, 24-hour volume $87,855,316.63, circulating supply 1,004,211,363 AERO, and total supply 2,002,379,494 AERO. CoinPaprika's returned circulating supply is the basis associated with its market cap; its supply methodology was not included in the response.

Using CoinPaprika daily USD point-in-time prices at 00:00 UTC on 2026-10-16 versus matching 00:00 UTC endpoints: AERO returned +14.18% over 7 days (0.815465 to 0.931106), +18.15% over 14 days (0.788059 to 0.931106), and +20.39% over 21 days (0.773378 to 0.931106). Formula: (ending price / starting price - 1) × 100.

On the same daily USD endpoints and formula, BTC returned -0.49%, -3.94%, and -2.46% over 7, 14, and 21 days; ETH returned -1.78%, -9.81%, and -9.12%. AERO outperformed BTC by 14.67, 22.09, and 22.85 percentage points, and ETH by 15.96, 27.96, and 29.51 percentage points, respectively. These are matched price-return comparisons, not risk-adjusted returns.

Across the returned 21-day daily observations, AERO's lowest and highest sampled prices were $0.773378 on 2026-09-25 and $0.954614 on 2026-10-11. These are observed daily sample extrema, not independently validated support or resistance levels.

The current ticker quote was updated at 11:15:15Z on 2026-10-16 and reports +13.86% over 7 days, while matched 00:00 UTC daily history endpoints yield +14.18%. The values use different observation times/windows and are not treated as a conflict.

DexPaprika identifies Base AERO as 0x940181a94a35a4569e4529a3cdfb74e38fd98631. Its highest-liquidity returned pool was Aerodrome AERO/USDC pool 0x6cdcb1c4a4d1c3c6d054b27ac5b77e89eafb971d. The pool-details response reported approximately $47.25M TVL, approximately $7.39M 24h turnover, and reserve values of approximately $23.71M USDC and $23.54M AERO. These are pool snapshot and turnover figures, not executable depth.

The returned AERO pools show liquidity and turnover distributed across Aerodrome volatile and SlipStream pools, including AERO/USDC and AERO/WETH or AERO/cbBTC pairs. Search results reported materially different 24h turnover and liquidity by pool; these values do not establish trade capacity. AERO/cbBTC SlipStream pool 0xdfe5f275020def30993f042174fc2d335678b626 reported approximately $2.63M liquidity and approximately $16.37M 24h turnover in details, a turnover-to-reported-liquidity ratio above 6 for the reported window; this warrants wash-trading, incentive-driven flow, and concentrated-liquidity range scrutiny, but does not prove manipulation.

For AERO/USDC SlipStream pool 0xbe00ff35af70e8415d0eb605a286d8a45466a4c1, the pool search returned approximately $6.17M liquidity and $1.16M 24h turnover, while its later details response reported approximately $7.50M liquidity and $1.16M turnover. The liquidity figures conflict across the two observations; snapshot timing and provider aggregation/method differences were not resolved.

Crypto.com Exchange exposed an AEROUSD CCY_PAIR instrument and returned a 20-level book snapshot at 2026-10-16T11:16:19Z. Best bid was 0.9175 USD and best ask 0.9238 USD, a 0.0063 USD quoted spread (about 0.68% of the 0.92065 USD midpoint). This is a centralized exchange order-book snapshot, not Base DEX depth; displayed levels can change or cancel, and no fees or fill simulation were provided.

No trade-size-specific Base DEX quote, swap simulation, or price-impact curve was retrieved. Pool TVL, reserves, and turnover cannot be used to infer executable depth. Crypto.com returned displayed order-book levels, but no order-size assumption was supplied and no fee-adjusted execution estimate was calculated.

The CoinPaprika Aerodrome Finance record contract string matches the AERO token contract used in DexPaprika Base pool results; the cross-source contract match supports identifying the researched Base asset.
No material AERO catalyst can be verified from this cycle: GDELT returned rate limits and no primary announcements were collected.

conflicts.description: The AERO/USDC SlipStream pool search returned liquidity_usd 6168998.05, while its subsequent detail response returned liquidity_usd 7501217.97. Both tool responses identified pool 0xbe00ff35af70e8415d0eb605a286d8a45466a4c1; the detail response's internal price_time was 2026-10-16T11:00:35Z, earlier than retrieval, so exact snapshot alignment is unclear.
conflicts.resolution_test: Repeat both read-only queries at a recorded common retrieval time and compare underlying reserve and active-liquidity methodology, if exposed.

coverage_gaps.description: CoinPaprika resolution returned the AERO contract with contract type 'Other' and did not return a chain/platform identifier. Therefore this response alone does not verify that the asset record is specifically the Base deployment.

No second qualified market-data provider was used. CoinGecko's only allowlisted tool in the repository capability snapshot is search_docs; its execute tool is UNKNOWN and not allowlisted, so no CoinGecko market observation was retrieved.
No qualified technical-indicator or OHLCV source was available within the used allowlist. Daily sampled extrema are reported as historical observations only, not formal support/resistance.
CoinPaprika returned circulating and total supply values, but this response did not provide the supply calculation methodology or unlock/emissions schedule.
No Base DEX swap quote or trade-size-specific slippage/price-impact curve was available in the invoked tool set. No executable capacity conclusion can be drawn from TVL, reserves, or turnover.
Only the first 10 liquidity-sorted pools were inspected; results indicated more pages. Full pool concentration across all AERO venues and independently verified reserve snapshots remain incomplete.
Fee fields for the returned DEX pools were null. Fee and routing impact are unknown.
Pool turnover data alone cannot test wash trading, incentive farming, or related-wallet concentration. No wallet-level or swap-level investigation was performed.
Crypto.com AEROUSD metadata names AERO/USD but does not provide a blockchain contract identifier; linkage to the Base AERO contract was not independently verified.
The Crypto.com book is a single snapshot; no size assumptions, order-book persistence, fees, or executed/slippage estimates were assessed.
GDELT discovery was attempted twice; both requests returned HTTP 429. No recent developments could be discovered or checked for duplicate/syndicated reporting.

No original Aerodrome announcements or other primary sources were obtained. Event occurrence, publication time, actual event time, upcoming dated catalysts within 21 days, and catalyst invalidation or delay conditions remain unverified.
No catalysts are asserted. Recent news and scheduled events could not be established from returned evidence.
